newsitem.title: UK: S&P says Ireland well placed for first EMU group.
newsitem.headline: S&P says Ireland well placed for first EMU group.

text.p: The Republic of Ireland's strong fiscal position leaves it well placed to be among the first countries participating in European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU), rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Thursday.
S&P said it will place increased greater emphasis on government finances in analysing countries that form the EMU bloc.
"Ireland's comparatively strong fiscal position leaves it well placed to be among the first to join," S&P said in a statement in which it affirmed Ireland's sovereign ratings.
A single European currency, one of the main features of EMU, is due to be introduced on January 1, 1999.
